title: Tomato and Egg Skillet
description: Sample Chef's Pick: eggs poached in a quick garlicky tomato sauce. Replace with your own recipe.
steps: Chop the tomatoes and slice the garlic.
Warm the oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and salt, then simmer for 10 minutes until saucy.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook for 5 minutes until the whites set.

title: Garlic Butter Chicken and Rice
description: Sample Chef's Pick: a one-pan weeknight dinner. Replace with your own recipe.
steps: Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and season with salt.
Melt the butter in a deep pan and brown the chicken for 5 minutes.
Stir in the garlic and rice for 1 minute.
Add the water, cover, and simmer on low for 18 minutes until the rice is tender.

title: Spinach and Cheddar Omelette
description: Sample Chef's Pick: a fast, filling breakfast. Replace with your own recipe.
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan and wilt the spinach for 1 minute.
Pour in the eggs and cook until nearly set.
Add the cheddar, fold the omelette in half, and serve.
